title: KnopiaPack
description: A Fabric modpack for SMP players, feature-rich yet lightweight, focusing on efficient building and unbridled creativity.
body:
# **About This Modpack**
This modpack is configured for SMP to make the game more convenient for SMP players who love building. It aims to add a wealth of useful features while significantly improving frame rates and moderately enhancing visual effects, making it friendly for potato devices.

## **Main features of KnopiaPack include:**
The masa series (Minihub/Tweakeroo/Litematica) & Simple Voice Chat. If you want to chat with your friends or other players while building beautiful houses or complex redstone machines from schematics, you should give this modpack a try. If you're not familiar with the masa series mods, that won't affect your normal gameplay either.

## **Finally**
It is recommended to rebind the keys according to your personal habits after installing this modpack. You are free to modify the mods to your liking after installation. Some features of the masa series mods may not work on all SMP servers, so please adjust them appropriately according to server rules when using those features. We also oppose installing any cheating mods, as they ruin the gameplay experience for other players. If you have any suggestions or feedback, please feel free to contact me!

The original configurations and resources in this modpack are licensed under CC BY 4.0. All mods included belong to their respective original authors.
# **关于此整合包**
针对SMP进行设置，以便喜爱建造的SMP玩家方便地进行游戏。此整合包旨在增加大量实用功能的同时大幅优化帧数并适当改善视觉效果，对土豆设备友好。
## **KnopiaPack主要的功能包括：**
masa系列(Minihub/Tweakeroo/Litematica) & 简单语音聊天，如果你希望一边跟你的朋友或者其他的玩家聊天，一边根据投影修建出漂亮的房子，或者复杂的红石机器，你应该试试这个整合包，若你不了解masa系列模组使用方法，那这些也不会影响到你正常游玩
## **最后**
建议在安装此整合包后按照个人习惯重新设置键位，安装整合包后您可以按照自己喜好自由更改模组，masa系列的部分模组功能不一定适用所有SMP服务器，所以使用masa系列模组功能时需要根据服务器规则适当调试，同时我们反对安装**任何作弊模组**，这样会破坏其他玩家的游戏体验，若有任何意见、建议欢迎联系我！
本整合包的原创配置与资源采用 CC-BY 4.0 许可。包内所有模组版权归原作者所有。
